description: A JSON number too large for hashicorp/hcl's exponent range becomes infinity
notes: The spec says a JSON number is translated exactly within the constraints of the information model, which requires an error when an integer can't be represented precisely or a number overflows. hashicorp/hcl parses numbers with go-cty's ParseNumberVal (parseNumber in json/parser.go), and Go's big.Float overflows to infinity while scaling by the exponent (Float.setExpAndRound in math/big); numbers whose binary exponent doesn't fit in a 32-bit integer, such as 1e2147483647, are rejected instead (json/expressions/number-exponent-beyond-binary-exponent-range-is-error).
